Extera.ImageCacheUnavailable: A complete cached image up to 32 MB is required. Let this photo finish loading in the gallery, then reopen Photo Tools.
Extera.ImageSearchDisclosure: Search uploads a JPEG copy, resized to at most 1280 pixels, to Yandex. Google Lens, Bing, and TinEye then receive Yandex’s image URL. The upload can make a private photo accessible to those services. Original EXIF and GPS metadata are removed from the uploaded copy. Nothing is uploaded until you confirm a provider.
Extera.ImageNoExif: No camera EXIF metadata is present in this cached image.
Extera.ImageSearchConfirm: Upload the previewed JPEG to Yandex and open the selected search service? Yandex receives the image for every provider; the selected provider receives its Yandex-hosted URL.
Extera.ImageUploading: Uploading the confirmed JPEG to Yandex…
Extera.ImageSearchUploaded: Image uploaded to Yandex. Search results open in the browser.
Extera.ImageSearchFailed: Image search did not return a usable result. The service may require browser verification or may have changed its upload endpoint. You can select a provider to explicitly retry.
Extera.ImageSearchCanceled: Upload canceled. Any bytes already sent may have reached Yandex.
Extera.ImageCopied: Image copied locally for two minutes. The copied JPEG excludes original EXIF and GPS metadata.
Extera.ImageFingerprintCopied: Cached file SHA-256 copied locally for two minutes.
